decision: recordings are keyed by the path the connector asked for, with Link next pages, connector class and provider; P2 counts connector classes, not files
why: the connector replays exactly what it read; two providers of one class are one connector
evidence: scripts/rehearsal/recording.ts; criteria.test.ts P2 flips with okta, linear and slack recordings made from fixtures (checked, then removed)

decision: scrub replaces ids, cursors, names, emails, hosts and token shapes with stable pseudonyms, whole values only, in bodies and in the paths keyed by them; findLeaks is the gate
why: joins through ids must survive; a substring rewrite would corrupt dates and counts
evidence: scrub.test.ts: raw leaks every kind, scrubbed none; replay gives the same records; mutations (no id key, no path rewrite) fail

decision: nothing is read or written unless the credentials are a sandbox's: Okta dev or trial org, Jira atlassian.net, Linear viewer and Jira account email at SANDBOX_DOMAINS, Slack token for SLACK_WORKSPACE, and every email read at a sandbox domain; seeding writes only with --apply and CROWBO_SANDBOX=yes
why: the kit must not touch a real company even if handed the wrong token
evidence: record.test.ts, seed.test.ts: foreign domain, foreign Slack workspace and non-dev Okta org are refused

decision: seeds plan from the sandbox's current state (pure planners) and apply round by round until nothing is missing
why: idempotent reruns; ids that exist only after a create are used in the next round
evidence: seed.test.ts: every provider converges and a rerun plans nothing; Okta and Jira seeds read back through the real connectors give the scenario lines

decision: Okta apps are keyed by label; name is the template key (bookmark, oidc_client) on real orgs
why: a real org's custom apps would all be called bookmark and joins would never match
evidence: fixtures now carry name bookmark and a label; engine and contract tests pass

decision: the Linear connector's named requests have their GraphQL documents (linearOperation); the contract test checks they select every field read on a paged fixture and only schema fields
why: a live read needs the real query
evidence: contracts.test.ts; removing endCursor from the selection fails it

decision: line() moved to its own module, breaking the cycle between the connector list and the connectors
why: seed.ts crashed on load (linear before initialization); tests import in an order that hid it
evidence: entrypoints.test.ts loads each module first in a fresh bun process; three fail on the old code

decision: staging does not read live through connections yet (fetchFor is not wired to a tenant's connections); the decision latency measurement waits for the staging deploy go-ahead
evidence: docs/REHEARSAL.md says which checklist line waits
